title: A box furnace serving a hot-rolling line: a 3-second door opening versus the complete extraction cycle
summary: A Suneng chamber-furnace discussion draft for a hot-rolling installation proposes door lifting/lowering within 3 seconds, with door heating, final-position clamping and front/rear temperature-control zones. Procurement should assess door movement, actual material pickup and delivery to the rolling mill separately. One mechanism's speed is not the complete production cycle.
